spans.s:
The final portion of a word, beginning with the last among the vowels in the word, is called टि।

Terms:

The affix यत् comes after a root that ends in a vowel.

Terms: यत्

Before the affixes having an indicatory ञ् or ण् , वृद्धि is substituted for the end-vowel of a अङ्ग (stem).

Terms: तद्धित वृद्धि

There is reduplication of यर् , i.e. all the consonants except ह after the letters र् and ह् following a vowel.

Terms: सन्धि-हल्
